pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which German word or phrase means "chair"? (1 mark)
   A. die Küche
   B. der Stuhl
   C. das Sofa
   D. das Radio

2. What does "in" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. between
   B. on
   C. behind
   D. in

3. What does "nett" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. small
   B. old
   C. tall or big
   D. kind

4. What does "der fünfte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. seventh
   B. third
   C. sixth
   D. fifth

5. Which word has the sound "ow" as in "cow"? (1 mark)
   A. Tier
   B. nein
   C. heute
   D. Haus

6. Which German word is the number 19? (1 mark)
   A. zwölf
   B. neunzehn
   C. eins
   D. elf

7. How is the letter F named in German? (1 mark)
   A. hah
   B. pay
   C. eff
   D. ah

8. What does "Wo ist Oma?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What does grandma cook?
   B. Where is grandma?
   C. Who is grandma?
   D. How old is grandma?

9. What does "der Finger" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tummy
   B. finger
   C. toe
   D. foot

10. Which German word or phrase means "rain"? (1 mark)
   A. der Wind
   B. das Wetter
   C. der Nebel
   D. der Regen

11. How is the "z" pronounced in "zehn" in the tongue twister about ten goats? (1 mark)
   A. like s
   B. like sh
   C. like ts
   D. like z in zoo

12. What does "lesen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to have a shower
   C. to read
   D. to drink

13. What does "der Dienstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. Thursday
   C. week
   D. Tuesday

14. How many German days of the week end in -tag? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 7

15. What does "vor" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. next to
   B. in front of
   C. behind
   D. between

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write three words from a Kenyan greeting or from German that must begin with a capital letter, and say why. (3 marks)

17. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bathroom, potato, milk. (3 marks)

18. Write a short German dialogue of three lines in which two children greet each other, ask their names and answer. (3 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tummy, apple, cheese. (3 marks)

20. Write the forms of "haben" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — der Stuhl
   chair in German is der Stuhl.

2. D — in
   in means in.

3. D — kind
   nett means kind.

4. D — fifth
   der fünfte means fifth.

5. D — Haus
   The letters au sound like ow.

6. B — neunzehn
   19 in German is neunzehn.

7. C — eff
   In German the letter F is called eff.

8. B — Where is grandma?
   wo means where.

9. B — finger
   der Finger means finger.

10. D — der Regen
   rain in German is der Regen.

11. C — like ts
   z sounds like ts, so zehn is tsayn.

12. C — to read
   lesen means to read.

13. D — Tuesday
   der Dienstag means Tuesday.

14. A — 6
   Montag, Dienstag, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag and Sonntag. Only Mittwoch does not.

15. B — in front of
   vor means in front of.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen, Amina, Kenia. Nouns, names and the first word of a sentence begin with capitals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for examples, 1 mark for nouns, 1 mark for names.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: Hallo! Wie heißt du? B: Ich heiße Otieno. A: Ich heiße Amina.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for the question Wie heißt du?, 1 mark for the answer with Ich heiße.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich habe, du hast, er hat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.
